correctness.rationale: Each of the five source matrices was reconstructed exactly. The verifier expands its determinant, extracts the degree-two normal part along the stated rank-two double line, and checks the displayed discriminant factorization. Every binary quadratic factor has negative discriminant and positive leading coefficient, hence no real projective zero; coprimality and nonsingular quadratic factors give four distinct nonreal complex roots. The claim is limited to this tangent-cone computation and does not infer unverified global normalization properties.
